findings.first_evidence: lib/demo/nyhavna-lokal/board.ts:232 -- matches.set(destination.id, scoped ? { ...destination, childPOIs: scoped } : destination);
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the active theme into findBoardPOI for highlight_places and show_place in executeBoardTool, using the existing preferCategoryId argument, and keep boardToolTargets consistent with that resolved theme. When a presentation directive needs to select a different theme, carry the intended category explicitly or ensure the browser's current theme is updated before resolution. Add a regression that executes find_similar_places directives for a centre café while Servering is active and asserts that Servering and its scoped member register remain selected.
findings.title: Preserve the active theme when showing centre members
findings.why_it_matters: Opening a centre from a food-theme answer can move the user to the first category containing that centre and display that category's child register. The UI already models centre copies as category-scoped and `findBoardPOI` supports a preferred category, so passing the current category lets the agent open the same centre card the user would see in that context.
findings.validation_reason: When a centre ID exists in both Hverdagsliv and Servering and Servering is active, lib/realtime/board-tools.ts:56 and :82 omit state.activeCategoryId from findBoardPOI, whose documented fallback at components/variants/report/board/board-data.ts:311-314 returns the first category copy and then navigates there at board-tools.ts:61-64/:86; the shopping fixture makes this state reachable, although no browser-directive test measures it.

evidence: lib/demo/nyhavna-lokal/presentation.ts:77 — `result: { matches: 1, place: target, ... }` — same leak on the similar-places path; only the directives were mapped (line 78).

lib/demo/nyhavna-lokal/voice.ts:301 — `STEDER OG REISETIDER (data): ${JSON.stringify(dataset.places.map(p => ({ id: p.id, ... })))}` — the instruction hands the model every store id as a first-class place id; buildCuratedProvider (voice.ts:186-189) was updated to carry `map_poi_id` but this block was not.

Consequence path: board-tools.ts:60 `return { error: `Ukjente kart-ID-er: ${rejected.join(", ")}. Ingen steder ble fremhevet. ...` }` — the whole highlight fails when every requested id is a member id.
Before this change these ids were valid board POI ids, so the same model behaviour succeeded; the regression is introduced by removing members from `poisById`/`categories[].pois` (board.ts:307).

Direct inspection: radius.ts DISCOVERY_CATEGORIES contains only trening-aktivitet and natur-friluftsliv; current shopping members belong to Hverdag/Servering, so nearby/reveal examples are excluded from this claim.
findings.first_evidence: lib/demo/nyhavna-lokal/presentation.ts:78 -- directives: [{ name: "highlight_places", args: { poi_ids: mapIds([target.id]) } }, { name: "show_place", args: { poi_id: mapIdByPlace.get(target.id) ?? target.id } }],
findings.suggested_fix: Expose map_poi_id alongside child knowledge IDs in similar().place and the STEDER OG REISETIDER prompt using parentPlaceId ?? id, matching buildCuratedProvider. Add a test that both emitted model-facing objects preserve child id and expose the parent map id.
findings.title: Model-facing result payloads still carry non-map child ids
findings.why_it_matters: Shopping members lose their standalone map markers, but find_similar_places returns the child object without map_poi_id and the STEDER OG REISETIDER prompt lists child IDs without their map identity. A follow-up model-authored highlight using those IDs is rejected by board-tools.ts. The generated immediate directives are mapped correctly; the missing mapping affects follow-up actions from these model-facing data surfaces. Actual model incidence was not measured. Radius-only nearby/reveal payloads do not include the current shopping categories.
findings.validation_reason: For a shopping child returned by find_similar_places, lib/demo/nyhavna-lokal/presentation.ts:77 exposes only the child id while :78 maps only the immediate directives, and voice.ts:301 likewise exposes child ids without map_poi_id even though board-tools.ts:56-60 rejects those ids after children were removed from board lookup; actual model-authored follow-up incidence was not measured.

findings.title: Parent mapping lacks similar-place coverage
findings.why_it_matters: The similar-place path has its own map directives, so a regression here can highlight or open a child store ID that no longer exists in poisById even while the presentation-path test remains green. Users asking for a similar shop would then receive correct store narration but a missing or stale map selection.

All three findings concern internal theme/map identity or test coverage; none alleges a protected-subject failure. No source edits were made. Parent fixes after the frozen patch are not evaluated here.

rejected_claims.title: Information Leakage: map identity policy is duplicated
rejected_claims.reason: Four identical, one-expression field defaults do not establish a material maintenance burden in this bounded adapter; an additional helper is optional style here.

rejected_claims.title: Repeated find_similar_places inside one centre never moves the map
rejected_claims.reason: The explicit intent retains individual searchable business facts with a shared centre map destination. Distinct businesses at one destination are valid alternatives; map movement is not a required outcome, and removing them would reduce intended breadth.

rejected_claims.title: Reserve reveal emits absorbed store ids the map rejects
rejected_claims.reason: The supplied radius.ts filters to training and nature. Current shopping members use Hverdag/Servering, so the asserted trigger is absent; a hypothetical future training member is outside the frozen content scope.

rejected_claims.title: New fixture co-locates all places, hiding the reveal regression
rejected_claims.reason: This assumes shopping members participate in radius discovery; category filtering excludes them regardless of coordinates. The proposed coordinate offsets cannot exercise the alleged failure.

rejected_claims.title: poiCategoryId on a standalone place breaks theme-id fallbacks
rejected_claims.reason: The claimed shopping-centre reveal affordance has no available radius options even with a valid Hverdag theme because radius discovery only supports training and nature. No consequential current trigger established.

rejected_claims.title: Additional peer residual claims
rejected_claims.reason: Unwired hiddenIds filter and hypothetical future poisById consumers lack reachable present consequences; numbered references describe map destinations and do not establish loss of transcript referents. Not retained as residual risks.

coverage.validator_shortcut_evidence: No retained finding has both ordinary and independently verified cross-model corroboration. Same-model agreement on #1 is not sufficient.

verdicts.reason: When a centre ID exists in both Hverdagsliv and Servering and Servering is active, lib/realtime/board-tools.ts:56 and :82 omit state.activeCategoryId from findBoardPOI, whose documented fallback at components/variants/report/board/board-data.ts:311-314 returns the first category copy and then navigates there at board-tools.ts:61-64/:86; the shopping fixture makes this state reachable, although no browser-directive test measures it.

For a shopping child returned by find_similar_places, lib/demo/nyhavna-lokal/presentation.ts:77 exposes only the child id while :78 maps only the immediate directives, and voice.ts:301 likewise exposes child ids without map_poi_id even though board-tools.ts:56-60 rejects those ids after children were removed from board lookup; actual model-authored follow-up incidence was not measured.

The new shopping-centres test at lib/demo/nyhavna-lokal/shopping-centres.test.ts:51-56 exercises only present_neighbourhood, while find_similar_places follows the separate presentation.ts:66-79 branch and no test selects a child target to assert both mapped directives; targeted tests could not run because this frozen tree has no vitest executable.

reviewer_selection.reason: voice tools and UI share map identities

verdict_reason: Fix #1 first so centre actions preserve the active theme, then expose parent map IDs on model-facing payloads (#3) and cover similar-place directives (#4). All three are confirmed by independent static inspection; model-authored follow-up incidence was not measured.
